# Training Industry: Four Questions for AI Impact


John Durocher, featured in Training Industry, explores four critical questions organizations should answer before agentic AI can deliver meaningful business results. The article examines how leaders can maximize AI's impact by redesigning workflows, establishing accountability, measuring business outcomes, and building the skills needed to effectively work alongside AI agents.
